text: Being here, I feel a pulse of curiosity and anticipation. The sleek, modern design and glass walls invite contemplation about transparency—how open are the boundaries between knowledge and those who seek it? The acronym 'R+D' and the wall of displays beckon me to reflect on the fusion between human intellect and technological innovation. I feel invigorated, as if on the threshold of discovery. This space reverberates with the excitement of inquiry and collaborative creation.
